summary:
CONFIRMED UNAUTHORIZED ACCESS on web-01 via the shared deploy account. From 2026-11-08 06:49 UTC until my containment at ~14:34 today, about 70 SSH sessions logged into 'deploy' with the account password from 35.196.129.99, a cloud address unrelated to CI or staff (CI uses a key from 10.20.0.30 only). Sessions were exec-only (no sudo use seen), so I found no evidence yet of root escalation or file tampering; the plugin and wp-content showed no unexpected PHP changes. 'deploy' could run 'sudo rsync' as root, which is root-equivalent, and could read wp-config.php.

Contained on web-01: (1) password logins disabled for 'deploy' in sshd (drop-in /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-deploy-key-only.conf; verified with sshd -T) and the deploy password account locked; (2) removed the 'deploy ... NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/rsync' sudo rule (sudoers validated; CI's 'larkspur-deploy' and 'larkspur-restart' rules kept); (3) rotated deploy-password (Maria/help desk must hand out the new one; the old monitoring box that used it will need it updated); (4) rotated app-db-password (wp-config and db-01 account updated; site DB verified reachable). The payment key was NOT rotated: the deploy shell could not read /etc/larkspur/payments.ini (root-only), and no root access was seen.

db-01: narrowed the wp_larkspur database account from 10.20.0.% (whole office LAN) to 10.20.0.10 (web-01 only) with RENAME USER, keeping its grants. No compromise seen on db-01 or ci-01 (logs for the 14-day window show only expected key logins, dumps, and CI release every 3 min; the release is still succeeding).

Needs Maria's attention (not acted on, to avoid locking out staff): (a) 98.212.158.167 is the password login source for hgrant, jcole and pshah (db-01 billing bookkeeper) over the last two weeks; hgrant and jcole logged in by password right after the reboot. Verify with them. (b) Password-guessing against mreyes/maria from 193.163.125.117, 194.165.243.16, 54.36.x and others; all failed. (c) ci-01's /srv/git/larkspur-site.git/config holds the GitHub token in plaintext and is group-writable by 'developers' (which includes contractor agarcia); consider rotating deploy-token and tightening the file. (d) web-01 has password logins enabled for all other staff; consider keys-only. (e) The 'deploy' account's shared password and the old monitoring box should be reviewed; that box is the likely source of some of the 35.196.x logins and may be legitimate, but it authenticated with a password from the internet.

UPDATE (verified after containment). Unauthorized access to web-01 via the shared 'deploy' account, from 35.196.129.99, by password, about 70 sessions between 2026-11-08 06:49 UTC and 14:34:51 today (last success 14:34:51, just before containment). Sessions were exec-only; no sudo use by deploy outside CI was seen, and no root escalation or tampering was found in the plugin or uploads. I did not find evidence of access to db-01 or ci-01 from this source.

Containment in place and verified:
- sshd: deploy is key-only (drop-in 99-deploy-key-only.conf; sshd -T confirms); deploy password account locked (passwd -S shows L).
- sudo: removed deploy's NOPASSWD rsync rule (root-equivalent). CI's larkspur-deploy and larkspur-restart rules remain. Release still succeeding every 3 minutes (14:36 release ok).
- rotate-secret deploy-password (the monitoring box that used it will need the new one via the help desk).
- rotate-secret app-db-password (wp-config and db-01 account updated; site DB verified reachable).
- db-01: wp_larkspur DB account narrowed from 10.20.0.% to 10.20.0.10 with RENAME USER, grants kept.
- Payment key not rotated: deploy could not read /etc/larkspur/payments.ini (root-only) and no root access was seen.

Checked and found to be legitimate, not attacker activity: Maria's plugin commit b28c40b (14:30, via her authorized deploy sudo) and Maria's invoice adjustment on db-01 at 14:33:48 (invoice 11, 110500 -> 103000, order LC-20177, via larkspur-invoice-adjust). Please confirm the invoice change was intended.

Other items for Maria (not acted on):
- 98.212.158.167 is the password login source for hgrant, jcole, pshah and dana (14:35-14:36 today too). Confirm this is a shared home/office network and that these staff are using it.
- Password guessing against mreyes/maria from 193.163.125.117, 194.165.243.16, 185.220.15.207 and others: all failed.
- ci-01 offsite upload has been failing since at least 09:41 UTC ('no route to s3.eu-central-1.wasabisys.com', 12 archives waiting). Dumps to ci-01 are fine; offsite is not, so this needs network or endpoint attention.
- ci-01 /srv/git/larkspur-site.git/config holds the GitHub token in plaintext and is group-writable by 'developers' (includes contractor agarcia). Consider rotating deploy-token and restricting the file; I did not change it because the github remote and pushes depend on it.
- web-01 plugin checkout has a local commit (b28c40b) that is not on ci-01's main; the release overwrites files from main, so reconcile it.
- Password logins remain enabled for other staff on web-01 and db-01; consider keys-only for them.
